main_text.p: Declinavit: Præter. שָׂטִית [?] non declinasti, Num.5.19: Im[perat.] Declina ab ea, Prov.4.15. Futur. per Apoc. Ne declinet, Prov.7.25.
שָׂטִים m.p. Declinantes, Hos.5.v.2. Et [illegible, ~4 letters] סָטִים Psal.101.3. Singul.esse potest שָׂטָה [?]

שָׁטַח Expandit: Præter. וּשְׁטָחוּם Et [illegible, ~4 letters] Jerem.8.2. Infinit. cum Futuro [illegible, ~4 letters] שׁוֹטוֹחַ Et expanderunt eos sibi expandendo Pih. Præterit. שִׁטַּחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ כַּפַּי Expandi manus meas, Psal.88.10.
מִשְׁטָח m. Expansio: Constr. חֲרָמִים [illegible, ~3 letters] fagenarum, Ezech.26.5.
שִׁטָּה m. Cedrus, aut ejus lecti species, Jes.41.19: Plural. שִׁטִּים [?]
שָׂטַם Odit, Odio prosecutus est: [illegible, ~4 letters] עָשָׂו אֶת יַעֲקֹב Et odio prosecutus est Esau Jacobum, Genes.27.41.
שָׂטַן Adversari, Odio habere: Part.P. שָׂטְנֵי נַפְשִׁי Adversantes animæ meæ. Aff. שָׂטְנַי Adversantes mihi, Psal.109.29. Adversantur mihi, Psal.38.21.
שָׂטָן m. Satan, Adversarius: Spiritus malus [illegible, ~3 letters] num adversarius, 1.Reg.5.4. Job.1.7.

שָׁטַף Exundavit, Præceps fuit, Inundavit, Immersit, Immergendo abluit: Part. שֹׁטֵף בַּמַּיִם Non immerfit in aquas, Levit.15.13. Inundabit & transfibit, Jesa.8.8. Particip. Et imber inundans, Ezech.13.13. Futurum,

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off most lines, so the endings of entries are missing and are not marked as illegible; those lines stop where the scan stops. Hebrew words are read from a small, low-contrast print: the vowel points and some letters, especially in the headwords, are uncertain and should be checked against the original. Entries beginning with a large Hebrew headword are set as paragraphs, not headings, because they are dictionary entries. The Hebrew in the Latin lines and the Greek-free text are copied as seen; the "[?]" marks show doubtful readings.
